correctness.rationale: For two coprime cubics x³+A and (x−λ)³+B in characteristic five with A,B≠0, genus-four Howe Jacobian has degree-2-isogeny decomposition into supersingular elliptic factors and genus-two C:y²=f1 f2; a(H)=2+a(C). Independently expanded f1 f2 squared and checked every displayed Cartier–Manin entry, its determinant ab((a+b)²−a+b−2), the rank-one nilpotence identity, and the resulting h(s)=2s¹⁰+2s⁸−s⁶+1 after λ≠0 normalization. Verified factorization as two irreducible cubics and irreducible quartic over F5, pairwise coprimality, squarefreeness, and gcd with ab and resultant exclusions. The ten distinct admissible roots all give a(H)=3. λ=0 gives only known B=−A superspecial a=4. Therefore exactly (q−1)(1+6·1_{3|m}+4·1_{4|m}) marked supersingular triples over F_{5^m}. This is arithmetic-geometric full-field proof, not interpolation from samples.
